pr_title: [MER-540] Introduce Sentry logging to new commerce frontend apps

comments.body:
Should include the throttling function. 
`import {limitErrorMessages} from '@createsend/shared/utils/sentryUtils';`
```
    beforeSend: limitErrorMessages,
    blacklistUrls: [/^https:\/\/cdn\.segment\.com\/analytics\.js/],
```
Not sure if there are more blacklist urls.
